description: Synthetic fixed observations for search-keep.jpp (construction check only; not model evaluation). Round 0 proposes three names: one fits and is kept, one exceeds four characters and is excluded by the code predicate `keep` before it ever reaches the judge, one is judged in-band (unsure) and is refined into round 1's context. Round 1's generation fixture is context-locked (`ctx`) to the exact frontier `search` should build: the round-0 accepted name, the still-undecided name, and the keep-excluded name, in that order — if `search` fails to carry the excluded material into the next round's frontier under `unsure_to: "refine"`, or carries it in the wrong slot, this fixture lookup misses and the run errors instead of silently passing. Round 1 proposes one more name that fits (reaching width 2, so the search stops) and two more over-length names that are again excluded by code, never judged. The calibration record is hand-written to exercise routing.
